cee.name: CEE Assam

eligibility.age: Minimum 17 years as on August 1 of admission year
eligibility.domicile: Must be permanent resident of Assam
eligibility.subjects: English must be one of the subjects

counseling_process.title: Registration
counseling_process.description: Register online at dte.assam.gov.in with CEE rank and personal details

counseling_process.title: Document Upload
counseling_process.description: Upload required documents including domicile certificate, mark sheets, caste certificate (if applicable)
documents: Class 10 admit card and mark sheet
CEE admit card and rank card

counseling_process.title: Choice Filling
counseling_process.description: Select preferred colleges and branches in order of preference
counseling_process.tips: Fill maximum choices to increase chances of getting preferred seat

counseling_process.title: Seat Allotment
counseling_process.description: Seats allotted based on CEE rank, category, and choices filled

counseling_process.title: Seat Acceptance
counseling_process.description: Accept allotted seat by paying admission fee at designated center

counseling_process.title: Reporting to College
counseling_process.description: Report to allotted college with original documents for verification
counseling_process.documents_required: All original documents + 3-5 photocopies of each

participating_colleges: Jorhat Institute of Science and Technology (JIST), Jorhat

eligibility.age: No age limit (born on or after October 1, 1999 for general, 1994 for SC/ST/PwD)
eligibility.domicile: All India (state quota and all India quota available)
eligibility.education: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics plus Chemistry/Biology/Biotechnology
eligibility.minimum_marks: 75% in 12th (65% for SC/ST) or top 20 percentile in qualifying exam

exam_details.negative_marking: 1 mark for each wrong MCQ answer

counseling_process_joasaa.title: JoSAA Registration
counseling_process_joasaa.description: Register at josaa.nic.in using JEE Main application number and password
counseling_process_joasaa.deadline: Within specified dates after JEE Advanced result

counseling_process_joasaa.title: Choice Filling
counseling_process_joasaa.description: Select preferred institutes and branches (IITs, NITs, IIITs, GFTIS)
counseling_process_joasaa.tips: Fill choices in order of preference; maximum choices is 300

counseling_process_joasaa.title: Seat Allotment
counseling_process_joasaa.description: 6 rounds of seat allotment based on JEE Main rank and preferences

counseling_process_joasaa.title: Seat Acceptance Fee Payment
counseling_process_joasaa.description: Pay Seat Acceptance Fee (SAF) to accept the allotted seat

counseling_process_joasaa.title: Document Verification
counseling_process_joasaa.description: Online document verification for allotted seat

counseling_process_joasaa.title: Reporting to Institute
counseling_process_joasaa.description: Report to allotted institute for admission and document submission
counseling_process_joasaa.documents_required: JEE Main admit card, rank card, class 10 and 12 certificates, category certificate, etc.

willingness_options.Float: Accept the allotted seat and participate in further rounds for higher preference
willingness_options.Freeze: Accept the allotted seat and do not participate in further rounds
willingness_options.Slide: Accept the allotted seat but try for higher branch in same institute

assam_colleges_through_jee.NIT Silchar: NIT with 50% seats for home state quota
assam_colleges_through_jee.Dibrugarh University: Participating in JoSAA for some seats

csab.name: CSAB
csab.description: CSAB conducts special counseling for NIT+ system if seats remain vacant after JoSAA

category_specific.OBC-NCL: OBC-NCL Certificate issued after April 1 of admission year
category_specific.EWS: EWS Certificate valid for current financial year
category_specific.PwD: PwD Certificate from authorized medical board

domicile.Other States: State domicile certificate if claiming home state quota

central_government.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
central_government.eligibility: Students with family income less than Rs. 1-2.5 lakh per annum

central_government.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
central_government.eligibility: Minimum 50% marks, family income less than Rs. 2.5 lakh

state_government.name: Assam Government Scholarship
state_government.eligibility: Students domiciled in Assam with good academic record
state_government.benefit: Varies based on category and income

jee.eligibility: Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks
jee.entrance_exam: JLEE Assam or JELET (for other states)
jee.branch: Same or related branch as diploma

details.JLEE: Joint Lateral Entrance Examination for Assam engineering colleges
